exact: Golgi vesicle fusion with ER-Golgi intermediate compartment membrane
Golgi vesicle fusion with ERGIC membrane

definition: The joining of the lipid bilayer membrane around a Golgi vesicle to the lipid bilayer membrane of the ERGIC. Such vesicles include COPI-coated transport vesicles involved in retrograde transport.
label: Golgi vesicle fusion with endoplasmic reticulum-Golgi intermediate compartment (ERGIC) membrane
